title: Training Reasoning Models in Simulation to Natively Use Real Robots
abstract: arXiv:2611.18562v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Robot-use agents (RUAs) have emerged as a promising approach to general-purpose robot control. However, strong performance has so far been achieved only by frontier proprietary models such as GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.2, whereas open-weight models remain substantially less capable. We show that an open-weight 27B reasoning model can be trained to use real robots natively through reinforcement learning, entirely in simulation and without demonstrations. Like a computer-use agent (CUA), the model observes the environment, reasons in a chain of thought, and generates the next end-effector pose, without any harness. translated_title: 在仿真中训练推理模型以原生使用真实机器人
translated_abstract: 机器人使用智能体（RUAs）已成为一种有前景的通用机器人控制方法。然而，迄今为止，强大的性能仅由 GPT-6 Astra 和 Claude Fable 5.2 等前沿专有模型实现，而开源权重模型的能力仍明显不足。我们展示了一个开源权重的 27B 推理模型可以通过强化学习被训练为原生使用真实机器人，训练完全在仿真中进行且无需任何演示数据。与计算机使用智能体（CUA）类似，该模型观察环境、进行思维链推理，并生成下一个末端执行器位姿，全程无需任何外部框架。我们构建了面向智能体机器人学的后训练引擎（PEAR），并利用它通过机器人使用强化学习（RURL）在大规模仿真机器人任务上训练该模型，这类似于前沿模型习得计算机使用能力的方式。我们发现，在仿真中习得的技能能够很好地泛化到训练任务之外：它们可以迁移……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出PEAR后训练引擎和RURL强化学习方法，仅通过大规模仿真训练（无需演示数据和外部框架），使开源27B推理模型获得可泛化到真实机器人上的原生机器人操控能力，缩小了开源模型与前沿专有模型的差距。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces PEAR and RURL, demonstrating that an open-weight 27B reasoning model can be trained entirely in simulation through reinforcement learning—without demonstrations or any harness—to natively control real robots, with simulation-learned skills that generalize well beyond the training tasks.
